request_contract.idempotency: request_id plus exact ordered ids, expected version, and client id
request_contract.external_change: collection, priority, identity, or editability changes stop remaining writes
request_contract.concurrent_submit: one active order is admitted; a second client receives busy, and the same request id cannot change content

write_contract.parent_child_lock: parent and child account leases gate each write and release permits a later tick
write_contract.credit_pause_reconciliation: owned pause records a parameter edit before write and clears it after a successful readback
write_contract.legacy_priority_queue: pending legacy priority operations block a new order admission

recovery_contract.restart_source: state is mutated only after an accepted submit so all required fields remain production-shaped
recovery_contract.dispatched_applied: verify observed target after restart without another upstream write
recovery_contract.dispatched_unapplied: record observed mismatch and finish needs_confirmation without replay
recovery_contract.pending_remaining: continue never-dispatched items exactly once after restart

read_only_and_failure.missing_state: read-only startup and view use defaults without creating account-priority-orders.json
read_only_and_failure.corrupt_state: invalid persisted JSON returns an explicit 503
read_only_and_failure.collection: adding or deleting a live account stops an active order before dispatch
